analysis:
The only changed line in this PR is docs/architecture/inference.md line 1409 (head). It adds a scheduler-configuration table row stating that decodeStepsBetweenPrefillChunks is 4 for the Qwen 3.5 family (including Qwen35MoEModel) and 0 otherwise, citing EngineV2Factory+Configuration.swift (`qwenDecodeStepsBetweenPrefillChunks`). This is documentation only. It changes no code, keys, protocol or deployment, and the supplied evidence shows no source change behind it. I reviewed both units for security-relevant claims and found no regression against the threat model.

The surrounding unchanged text covers the GLM5 serving and admission path, the calibration/warmup path, prompt-token caching, the ChunkBatcher/SendHandle encryption path, deadlines and the scheduler config table. It was read as context. It states fail-closed behavior for the encrypted chunk path (T-008) and does not weaken the per-account cache scoping, HMAC lookup or TTL posture of T-041/SEC-035. The doc does not propose any cache scope, TTL or encryption change.

Residual uncertainty: the Qwen scheduling change that the new row documents (decode-only steps between prefill chunks) is not visible in this batch. Its effect on first-token timing, and so on the T-041 same-account TTFT oracle, could not be assessed. It is a scheduling-fairness setting and does not touch key custody, attestation, authorization or the coordinator trust boundary. The accuracy of the row against the code is unverified, which is a documentation-correctness question, not a vulnerability. Other threat-model surfaces (TB-011/TB-012/TB-013) are not touched by this change.
